_about: Issue #114: GPU values of FLY_FS hKm recorded by scripts/engine-bench/flyheight.html (run.js, ANGLE d3d11). gpu[k] = [e, h, u, v]: the filtered grid height, hKm, and the warped texture coordinate for dirs[k].
